summary: PRODUCTION verification against https://align-report.emergent.host after the load_dotenv + deploy fix. Ran 10 backend tests covering all 4 review-request feature sets (pro share links, foundation merge, FV email-less flow, core regression) and a frontend UI smoke test. 10/10 backend PASS and all frontend smoke checks PASS. The new build is live and every previously-broken feature works: /join links contain the correct prod host, /join/<token> route renders, foundation_statements merge into agreement report and PDF (with 'Foundation Statements' section), FV pro-request accepts request without co_parent_email (200), prepare with empty body returns 400 and with {parent_a_email,parent_b_email} returns 200 producing an is_safety report visible to the pro. Core: /health 200, /api/joint/config returns 8 agreement_areas, /api/cron/completion-nudge returns 401 without token, full 6-key joint report cycle with non-blank PDF, share-to-pro shows in pro's report list. Frontend landing shows correct tagline, 5 pillar circles, journey step-one/step-two, professionals-invite section; Dashboard renders 3 circles (uniform purple / agreement green / safety red with 'Request Professional' pill) + 4 bubbles (educational/medical/psychological/co-parenting).

minor.issue: Field is named 'email' (not 'professional_email'). Minor naming inconsistency vs the FV-request endpoint which uses 'professional_email'. Not a bug — just note for API consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: The visible 'Request Professional' button under the safety circle does NOT carry data-testid='request-professional-pill' (query returned 0). Button works and is visible; only automated selector is missing.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='request-professional-pill' to the 'Request Professional' button in CircleNav.jsx to match the review spec and improve testability.
(Optional) Rename the /joint/reports/{id}/share body field from 'email' to 'professional_email' for consistency with the FV professional-request endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: load_dotenv(override=True) fix on backend/server.py is confirmed live in the deployed build — /join links now point at align-report.emergent.host. Keep this pattern; any future supervisor env leak would silently break share links again.
ProRequestIn now correctly treats co_parent fields as Optional — the prod FV email-less request returns 200 as designed.
generate_agreement + build_agreement_pdf correctly merge foundation_statements end-to-end and render the 'Foundation Statements' section in the PDF.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (tagline, 5 pillars, journey, professionals-invite, register-via-UI, dashboard 3 circles + 4 bubbles, Request Professional pill visible)

test_credentials: All accounts created dynamically via /api/auth/register with TEST_-prefixed @testmail.dev emails against the prod API. No admin credentials used.
seed_data_creation: Real prod data created (test parents, pros, reports, one agreement with foundation statement, one FV safety report). All prefixed TEST_ per review guidance; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prod verification suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_prod_verification.py; run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://align-report.emergent.host pytest backend/tests/test_prod_verification.py -v`. It hits prod directly (custom User-Agent required — CDN 403s bare python-requests otherwise). Share endpoint body key is 'email' (not 'professional_email'). Prepare endpoint requires either parent_a/b or a co_parent_email in body — empty body correctly returns 400. Frontend register flow: click the 'Create account' tab first (data-testid absent — use role/name); inputs have testids name-input/email-input/password-input; role radios have no testid — use `label:has-text("Parent")`.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this run is post-fix verification. Prior issue (stale APP_URL breaking share links) was resolved in iteration 15 by switching to load_dotenv(override=True) in backend/server.py, and the redeploy is now confirmed live via the /join link host and the FV-no-email endpoint returning 200.
